tokenize_text_with_bert: use BertTokenizer to tokenize text into wordpiece tokens using a vocab file
convert_tokens_to_ids: convert a list of wordpiece tokens into their corresponding vocabulary IDs
convert_ids_to_tokens: convert a list of vocabulary IDs back into their wordpiece tokens
load_pretrained_tokenizer: load a pretrained BERT tokenizer from a model name like bert-base-uncased
load_vocab_from_file: load a vocabulary file into an ordered dictionary mapping tokens to indices
